greeting.message: Hallo again! Need something from the quartermaster?

supplies-status.message: Everything's well-stocked and properly organized! A good quartermaster always knows exactly what they have and where to find it. That's the secret - organization!

resource-advice.message: The most important thing is to never let your essential supplies run too low. Keep a buffer - you never know when you'll need extra rations or materials. And always, always keep inventory organized!

responses.text: You really like organization, don't you?

organization.message: Like it? I *love* it! There's nothing quite as satisfying as a perfectly organized supply depot. Everything in its place, every item counted and accounted for. Beautiful!

friendly.message: Well, hallo to you too! Always happy to chat. Good morale is important for keeping the camp running smoothly, you know!
